info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening B I N  Lookup API

params.name: page
params.description: The current page based on the number of items per page. Use this value to iterate through all of the paginated data and to know when you are the end of the data.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to be displayed per page. The larger the number the slower the API will respond, but the less requests you will need to make for paginating through data. We recommend trying a page size of 1000 and adjusting for your needs.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by any parameter that the API returns with a direction (- for descending sort, + for ascending sort). For example -lowAccountRange will present the returned data in descending order based on the low account range values. The same is true for any of parameters such as customerName (+customerName) or ica (-ica).

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all account range information or filtered results based on search criteria applied
